PROP-20260317-mig-inv-002.text: Concurrent record_attendance_by_card calls for same user must not corrupt toggle state (TOCTOU on last type).
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-002.assertion: forall concurrent(c1, c2, same_user): serializable(c1, c2) => consistent_toggle_sequence(c1, c2)

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-003.text: card_id must map to at most one user; duplicate card_id across users causes incorrect attendance attribution.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-003.assertion: forall card_id: count(attendance.users WHERE card_id = card_id) <= 1

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-004.text: Exception handler must not expose SQLERRM internals to anon callers in error response JSON.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-004.assertion: forall exception(e) in record_attendance_by_card: response.message NOT contains(table_names, column_names, stack_trace)

PROP-20260317-mig-pre-003.text: Card ID input must be normalized before lookup to prevent bypass via encoding variants (case, whitespace, encoding).
PROP-20260317-mig-pre-003.assertion: forall call(_, record_attendance_by_card, p_card_id): normalize(p_card_id) == canonical_form(p_card_id)

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-005.text: anon role must have zero privileges on all member schema tables after fix_security_permissions migration.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-005.assertion: forall t in [members, teams, member_team_relations, team_leaders, generation_roles]: privileges(anon, member.t) == {}

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-006.text: anon role must have zero privileges on attendance.attendances, attendance.users, attendance.daily_logout_logs.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-006.assertion: forall t in [attendances, users, daily_logout_logs]: privileges(anon, attendance.t) == {}

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-007.text: anon must retain only SELECT (not INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) on attendance.temp_registrations.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-007.assertion: privileges(anon, attendance.temp_registrations) == {SELECT} AND NOT includes({INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE})

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-008.text: All member schema tables must have both ENABLE and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY after migration.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-008.assertion: forall t in member_tables: rls_enabled(t) AND rls_forced(t)

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-009.text: All attendance schema tables must have FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY to prevent service key bypass.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-009.assertion: forall t in [attendances, users, temp_registrations, daily_logout_logs]: rls_forced(t)

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-010.text: record_attendance_by_card must be the only EXECUTE grant to anon after permission tightening.

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-011.text: SECURITY DEFINER function must not allow anon to write to tables beyond attendance.attendances INSERT.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-011.assertion: forall op in record_attendance_by_card: write_ops(op) ⊆ {INSERT INTO attendance.attendances}

PROP-20260317-mig-asm-001.text: RLS policies must exist for every table with FORCE RLS; otherwise all queries are denied (implicit deny).
PROP-20260317-mig-asm-001.assertion: forall t WHERE rls_forced(t): exists policy(t) AND policy(t).permissive == true FOR required_ops

PROP-20260317-mig-asm-002.text: Authenticated users reading team_leaders/generation_roles via USING(true) must not leak sensitive admin data.
PROP-20260317-mig-asm-002.assertion: forall row in team_leaders ∪ generation_roles: no_sensitive_fields(row) OR field_level_access_control(row)

PROP-20260317-mig-asm-003.text: Future tables in member/attendance schemas must not auto-grant privileges to anon (DEFAULT PRIVILEGES revoked).
PROP-20260317-mig-asm-003.assertion: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA member REVOKE ALL FROM anon AND same for attendance

PROP-20260317-mig-pre-004.text: Anon RPC calls must be rate-limited to prevent attendance record flooding via automated card_id enumeration.
PROP-20260317-mig-pre-004.assertion: forall caller_ip, window(60s): count(calls(caller_ip, record_attendance_by_card)) <= rate_limit_threshold

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-012.text: Toggle logic must default first attendance to 'in' when no prior record exists for the user.

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-013.text: Attendance date must be derived from timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo'; date and timestamp must be consistent.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-013.assertion: forall attendance(a): a.date == (a.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo')::date

PROP-20260317-mig-post-001.text: record_attendance_by_card must return well-formed JSON on all execution paths including exceptions.
PROP-20260317-mig-post-001.assertion: forall call(record_attendance_by_card): result IS valid_json AND has_key(result, 'success')

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-014.text: display_name fallback must query auth.users only when member.members.display_name IS NULL.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-014.assertion: forall rpc_call: (display_name IS NULL) => fallback_to(auth.users.global_name) AND (display_name IS NOT NULL) => no_auth_query

PROP-20260317-mig-inv-015.text: SECURITY DEFINER function must not allow cross-schema access beyond attendance and member schemas.
PROP-20260317-mig-inv-015.assertion: record_attendance_by_card accesses only: attendance.*, member.members, auth.users (read-only fallback)

PROP-20260317-mig-asm-004.text: RPC function runs as SECURITY DEFINER; callers must not influence execution path beyond p_card_id parameter.
PROP-20260317-mig-asm-004.assertion: forall call(anon, record_attendance_by_card): caller_influence ⊆ {p_card_id} AND no_dynamic_sql(p_card_id)

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-001.text: Middleware must validate OAuth cookie values cryptographically, not just check presence.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-001.text: force-logout-all API must require authentication, not rely solely on time window.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-001.assertion: forall req: force_logout_all(req) => req.is_authenticated == true AND is_admin(req.user) == true

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-002.text: Discord server membership verification must be active and enforced at login callback.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-003.text: Users must not be able to UPDATE their own role field via RLS-permitted self-update.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-003.assertion: forall u: update_user(u, fields) => 'role' NOT IN fields OR is_admin(u) == true

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-004.text: temp_registrations RLS must restrict anonymous INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-004.assertion: forall op in {INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE}: temp_registrations(op, role=anon) => DENIED

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-005.text: card_id normalization must reject characters outside [a-f0-9] after colon removal and lowering.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-005.assertion: forall card_id: normalize(card_id) => result matches /^[a-f0-9]+$/ OR reject

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-002.text: auth_next cookie redirect target must be validated against same-origin allowlist.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-003.text: SECURITY DEFINER functions must parameterize all inputs to prevent SQL injection.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-003.assertion: forall fn in SECURITY_DEFINER: fn.inputs => parameterized_query(fn.inputs) == true

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-006.text: Admin client (service_role) must only be instantiated in server-side code, never client-side.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-007.text: OAuth authorization codes must not be logged, even partially, in production.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-008.text: Authenticated users must not read other users' discord_uid or PII from member table.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-008.assertion: forall u: SELECT member.members WHERE id != u.id => exclude(discord_uid, email)

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-009.text: Kiosk access token must be transmitted via header or cookie, not URL query parameter.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-009.assertion: forall req: kiosk_auth(req) => token NOT IN req.url.searchParams

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-004.text: force-logout-all must enforce per-day invocation limit to prevent repeated mass logout.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-005.text: createTempRegistration must rate-limit per card_id to prevent registration reset spam.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-005.assertion: forall card_id, window: count(create_temp_reg(card_id, window)) <= RATE_LIMIT

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-006.text: record_attendance_by_card RPC must enforce rate limiting per card_id.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-006.assertion: forall card_id, window: count(record_attendance(card_id, window)) <= RATE_LIMIT

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-010.text: RLS FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY must be enabled on all user-facing tables.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-010.assertion: forall table in user_tables: ALTER TABLE table FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY == enabled

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-011.text: record_attendance_by_card must reject malformed card_id without crashing RPC.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-012.text: OAuth callback must handle malformed or missing code parameter without unhandled exception.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-013.text: completeRegistration must handle missing or malformed token without server crash.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-007.text: OAuth redirect_uri must be validated against registered URIs before code issuance.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-pre-007.assertion: forall req: issue_auth_code(req) => req.redirect_uri IN app.redirect_uris

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-014.text: PKCE code_challenge must be verified on token exchange to prevent authorization code interception.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-014.assertion: forall exchange: token_exchange(code) => verify_pkce(code.challenge, req.verifier) == true

PROP-kintai-v3-st-asm-002.text: PKCE flow in Supabase Auth must reject replayed authorization codes.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-asm-004.text: KIOSK_ACCESS_TOKEN must have sufficient entropy (>=128 bits) to prevent brute force.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-018.text: Temp registration token must expire exactly 30 minutes after creation.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-019.text: Token validity requires both is_used=false AND expires_at >= now().
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-019.assertion: forall t: use_token(t) => t.is_used == false AND t.expires_at >= now()

PROP-kintai-v3-st-post-001.text: After completeRegistration, temp_registration.is_used must be true.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-021.text: temp_registration must be marked used AFTER card link succeeds, not before.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-021.assertion: forall t: mark_used(t) => card_link_success(t.card_id, t.user_id) == true

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-022.text: Authorization code must expire within 10 minutes of issuance.

PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-026.text: card_id and qr_token must be globally unique across temp_registrations.
PROP-kintai-v3-st-inv-026.assertion: forall t1, t2: t1 != t2 => t1.card_id != t2.card_id AND t1.qr_token != t2.qr_token
